parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: The member UID. You must specify either UserId or MemberId. You cannot specify both.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The user UID. For more information about how to view the user UID, see [ListWorkspaceUsers](~~449133~~). You must specify either UserId or MemberId. You cannot specify both.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
